title: Before You Were Born
old_p1: Long ago a young man named Jeremiah heard a quiet voice. It was Heavenly Father, and He said, 'Before I made you, I knew you.'
Jeremiah looked down at his own small hands. 'But I am only a child,' he whispered. 'I do not know how to speak.'
Heavenly Father did not say, 'Yes, you are too little.' He said, 'Do not say you are a child. Go where I send you.'
old_p2: 'Do not be afraid,' He told Jeremiah, 'for I am with thee.' The quiet inside Jeremiah's chest grew warm and steady.
Heavenly Father knew you before you were born, too. He knew your laugh and your sleepy eyes. You are little tonight, and you are already His.
p1: Long ago, Heavenly Father’s people had stopped listening to Him. So Heavenly Father chose a young man named Jeremiah to be His prophet. A prophet tells the people what Heavenly Father says.
Heavenly Father said to Jeremiah, “Before I made you, I knew you.”
Jeremiah looked at his small hands. “But I am only a child,” he said. “I do not know how to speak.”
p2: Heavenly Father did not say, “Yes, you are too little.” He said, “Do not say you are a child. Go where I send you. Do not be afraid, because I am with you.” Then Jeremiah felt warm and brave inside.
Heavenly Father knew you before you were born, too. He knew your laugh and your sleepy eyes. You are little tonight, and you are already His.

stone_name: That small-and-not-ready feeling is called unsure. Your mind might think, “I am too little for this.” Your body might feel wobbly, with shaky hands and a quiet voice.
